name: the compact bar ignores its setting
why: sa_sl_compact_nav defaults to off. Without the gate every user of the springsteenlyrics.com support gets the site's walls of links replaced without asking.

name: a filter the site carries over counts as the wall's own
why: On a filtered page every country/album/copies link also carries f_format=12i. Taking every f_* parameter as the wall's own key merges walls into one Format menu and breaks the labels.

name: the site's red (active) entry is read from its href
why: The active entry's href DROPS its own filter (a click removes it). Read from the href it has no value, so the bar shows the raw parameter (12i) instead of the site's label.

name: a new scope keeps the page parameter
why: Page 2 of the old scope can be past the end of the new one; every choice must start at page 1.

name: a category change keeps the album filter
why: f_date_main names an Official Albums title; carried into another category it narrows that list to nothing.

name: the walls are not hidden
why: The point of the bar is the room the walls take, pinned, above the list.
grep: pinned area above the list shrinks

name: reversed year pickers are not put in order
why: The server answers f_range=1990,1985 with nothing; a from year after the to year must be swapped.

name: a scroll closes the open pull-down
why: Opening a menu can itself scroll the page (focus, scroll-into-view); closing on every scroll shut menus the moment they opened.

name: a bootleg category change keeps the search parameters
why: A bootleg list category ignores f_date/f_title (probed live): the target URL would carry a filter that does nothing and reads as if it applied.

name: a filtered list records its total as the category's
why: album with f_format=12i has 539 items, the album category 1315: recording the filtered total would put a wrong exact count in the menu.

name: a bootleg search page (category=f_*) records a count
why: A search's total is not a category's. Not visible on its own: every such page also carries its f_* parameter, which the next guard rejects, so the spec stays green. Kept for the day a search arrives without one.

name: the era timeline is sized by raw counts, not per year
why: A thirteen-year era with 222 recordings would tower over a one-year tour with 159; the timeline is meant to show how densely each era was recorded.

name: the timeline does not mark the current era
why: The site marks no current category on the bootleg lists; marking it was one of the reasons for the bar.

name: an era never visited is drawn as if counted
why: Unknown must look unknown; a bar with a made-up height would read as a real count.

name: the bootleg Category menu offers "All categories"
why: Only the collection has an "all" list; on bootlegs.php the entry would lead nowhere useful.
grep: records its exact count; the menu shows it

name: the search forms are not hidden
why: The box stands in for the four forms; left visible they still take their pinned row above the list.

name: Auto never reads a date
why: Auto is what makes one box do: a typed date must search the date field, not titles.

edits.find: const asDate = field === 'f_date' || (field === 'auto' && d && search.fields.some(f => f.param === 'f_date'));

grep: a date in any common form

name: a day the calendar does not have is accepted
why: Without the check 1975-02-30 becomes a search the server answers with nothing, which is exactly the silent empty list the site's dead checkForm() gives.

edits.find: return (dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d)

grep: a day that does not exist

name: a partial date finds no era
why: The site cannot search a month; the era list that holds it is the useful answer.

edits.find: const era = eras.find(e => d.y >= e.span.from && d.y <= e.span.to);

name: Enter does not search
why: The site's forms submit on Enter; the box must too.

name: a search result page opens with an empty box
why: Refining a search starts from the search you are looking at.

name: Recent repeats a search instead of moving it up
why: Opening the same search twice would fill the eight slots with copies.

name: Recent grows without bound
why: A menu of every search ever made is not a recent list.

name: after the fetch nothing filters the table
why: The hand-off itself: without it every choice reloads the page and throws the loaded table away.

edits.find: return idx >= 0 ? { table, idx, column } : null;

grep: Country filters the table in place

name: a filter the list was fetched with is offered as a table filter
why: With f_country=USA in the query the table holds only USA rows; another country as a table filter shows nothing, when only a reload can widen the list.

edits.find:
if (facet.keys.some(k => params.has(k))) return null;
        const table = _slLoadedTable();

grep: still reloads: the table holds only that value

name: the bar does not follow a column cleared elsewhere
why: Cleared with the column's own ✕, the bar would still show the country and its chip.

name: a choice nothing matches clears the column instead
why: An empty value set means "no filter" to applyUniqValueSet(): a year range with no items would show EVERY row.

name: two table filters get a reloading Clear all
why: With only table filters active there is nothing in the query to drop; a reload would just refetch the same list.

name: a pull-down near the window's bottom hangs past it
why: A fixed panel cannot be scrolled into view; its lower entries were out of reach once the bar sat low.

name: the bootleg landing page is touched with the bar off
why: The landing page has nothing to consolidate; with sa_sl_compact_nav off the script would still inject a heading and a toolbar with nothing to do, on a page the user only enabled the lists for.
grep: with the bar off, the page is left alone

name: the landing page's @include line no longer matches
why: The fixture harness injects unconditionally; only the @include spec notices a pattern Tampermonkey would never match.

name: the bar is not installed on a navigation-only page
why: The landing page is supported for the bar alone.
grep: with the bar on: Category, the search box and Recent

name: the landing page keeps the Data and View menus
why: Without a table they act on nothing, and the divider leads a toolbar with no fetch button.
grep: with the bar on: Category, the search box and Recent

name: the landing page's Category reads "All categories"
why: The bootleg lists have no "all" list; the landing page shows none and should invite a choice.
grep: with the bar on: Category, the search box and Recent

name: a row is filed under its LAST medium
why: The server files an item under its first medium (probed: "VHS + CD" is vhs). "CD + 2xDVD" filed as DVD would leave the CD filter short of rows the site counts as CD.
grep: Format filters the table by first medium

name: Format never filters the loaded table
why: Without the glossary mapping Format reloads the page and throws the loaded table away, the one menu part 4 had to leave out.

edits.find:
// medium, as the server files it (probed, see that table).
        f_format: 'Format'
edits.replace: // medium, as the server files it (probed, see that table).

grep: Format filters the table by first medium

name: the site's Formats guide panel stays beside the Format menu
why: The menu carries the guide; the panel would keep its pinned row for nothing.
grep: Formats guide panel goes with the format wall

name: the guide panel's box is hidden even when it holds the page
why: A guard against a future page where the panel's nearest .container is the page's own. Not visible: on every fixture the panel has its own box, so the spec stays green.
grep: Formats guide panel goes with the format wall

name: Format cells carry no guide text
why: The guide's third place: hovering a cell is where "4xCD + 2xBlu-ray" needs explaining.
grep: every collection Format cell carries its guide text

name: Format menu entries lose their guide line
why: Without it the menu is the site's chip labels again, and "mc" finds nothing.

edits.find: const sub = fmt ? `${fmt.abbr} · ${fmt.text}${fmt.guide ? '' : ' (not in the site\'s guide)'}` : '';

grep: the Format menu is the guide
